svg.text: THE SAME SCALE (1 px = 0.95 m). DIAGRAM FROM THE PLAN DATA: not a screenshot, nothing built.
Pink square: the home block to the ring road's outer kerb (v2 150 m; Compact 124 m). Red: the four landmarks' footprints. Purple: the pub and the club.
Blue: every street, lane and path within 25 s of sprinting from ANY fort's mat (235 m along the walking network, the measured curve).
In v2, 25 s gets you through the starter streets. In Compact Queens it reaches all four landmark doors: each fort's own is 24-25 s, the far corner 33-34 s.
